en: You're looking into something, I hear, but I
can't do much to help you there.
Well, hang in there.
, it's you! Good of you to come.
How about it? Stay for a bite while you're here?
No, let's make it another time.
Aw, come on, don't be shy.
...Don't tell me you don't like meat?
Come on by whenever you're hungry.
Morning! Up early for a young fella. I'm impressed.
You're up very early yourself.
Oh, and polite to boot!
Pleased to meet you, Malcolm.
Yes, I'm still new to London.
But I'm not lost, I assure you.
Thank you. Until next time, then.
I hope we'll get along. Good night, then.
Hey,
You must be real carefree or real gutsy.
Lots of workers round here. Some of 'em
Good afternoon. Oh, so this is a butcher's?
I smelled blood and couldn't help coming in.
(Oh no! Will he suspect me?)
note: Thought after a pause; it continues on the same line as #5061 / #5067.

en: Some nose you've got there! I'm amazed.
I-is that so? Do take care of it...
I've just remembered an errand. Excuse me.
Good afternoon. I thought I'd drop by.
I notice the smell of blood more than meat.
Sadly, I'm still on my own.
A ladies' man like you!
Hurry up and find yourself a pretty wife!
Come by the shop and I'll give you a deal!
No, thank you kindly, but another time...
What's up? What brings you here this late?
Too late to browse the shop or grab a meal.
Malcolm, forgive me!
Wh-what's this, apologizing all of a sudden?
I have no time to spare.
Please, lend me your strength.
note: No used_in in the slice, but msg.py shows it after #5077 in msg 202890 (player, before biting Malcolm).

en: What the hell are you doing?! Aaagh!
What is your wish today...
note: Follows the #854 variant ', my master. ' on the same line: starts with a capital.

en: I feel so sluggish... and sleepy.
I'm all cut up, too... but oddly, it doesn't hurt.
It gives me the creeps.
I'll do as you wish...
note: Follows #0 ', my master...' on a new line.

en: I had a dream I was beating up women and kids.
That didn't really happen... did it?
Move aside, you. You're in the way.
I can't get by with you standing there.
I'm not used to these streets.
Huh, so you're a stranger here.
Just don't block the way.
Wander around too much and people'll get suspicious.
Fancy seeing you first thing in the morning.
Oh well. I'm off to work now.
Nothing's gone right lately, so honestly,
I'd been sulking.
But somehow I've got a feeling something good
is coming. I hope it really happens.
I would like to ask the way.
Sure, but I don't know the area that well.
I just go between the factory and home.
I don't go places I've no business in.
I see. So that's how it is.
And what sort of work do you do, may I ask?
What do you want to know that for?
You're a strange one.
I work at the factory. It's a lousy job.
What? You want something?
, it's you. Hi.
You seem livelier at night.
Me, I'm worn out after a day at the factory.
Even at home, all I do is eat and sleep.
Hey, how's it going? You well?
I'm not too tired today myself.
I wish it was always like this.
Work again tomorrow... Guess I'll keep at it.
You take care too. See you.
Hey, this is a factory. You can't come in here.
I didn't know I was not permitted to enter.
